newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Ekovest says gets university contract.
newsitem.headline: Ekovest says gets university contract.

text.p: Malaysian construction company Ekovest Bhd said on Tuesday it had been awarded a contract to build a university in the eastern Malaysian state of Sabah on Borneo island.

In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange, Ekovest said: "Our 40 percent associate company Syabas Hakikat Sdn Bhd had on April 30, 1997 received a letter of award from the Government of Malaysia for the construction of the above project at a contract value of 345 million ringgit."
Ekovest said the contract has a tenure of 18 months starting from May 2, 1997, and is due to be completed on November 1, 1998.
